title: Recipe Inputs and Ingredient List Creation Enhancements
description: Make recipe instructions optional, support recipe name field as plain name or source URL, and add a direct action to create an ingredient list from recipe ingredients.

tasks.title: Adjust recipe validation and rendering for optional instructions
acceptance_criteria: Recipe API accepts create/update payloads when Instructions is omitted or empty
Create/Edit recipe forms no longer require Instructions in client-side validation
Recipe details page handles missing instructions gracefully
tasks.notes: Removed required validation for instructions on API/web models, normalized instruction persistence to empty string when omitted, and added empty-state rendering on details page.

tasks.title: Update name field semantics to allow recipe name or recipe URL
acceptance_criteria: Recipe create/edit forms label Name field as name or recipe URL
No server-side validation rejects URL-formatted values in Name
UI helper text clarifies intended usage
tasks.notes: Updated create/edit form labels and helper text so the field is explicitly treated as recipe name or source link.

tasks.title: Add create ingredient list action from recipe ingredients
acceptance_criteria: Recipe details page exposes an action to create a new ingredient list from the recipe
Ingredients are split by line and added as individual ingredient items
Successful creation navigates to the new ingredient list detail page
Failure states show a user-visible error message
tasks.notes: Added Recipe Details action to create a new ingredient list from newline-split ingredients, add each line item, and navigate to the new list.

dependencies: Requires existing IngredientListApiClient create list and add ingredient methods
